description: This file defines the internal sealed class SlabMemoryPool, which extends MemoryPool<byte>. It manages a pool of memory blocks and slabs for efficient memory allocation and reuse, primarily used for allocating fixed-size memory blocks aligned with OS page sizes. The class includes methods for renting, leasing, allocating slabs, returning blocks, and disposing resources, with internal tracking of allocated blocks and slabs.

classes.name: SlabMemoryPool
classes.description: A memory pool implementation that manages slabs and blocks for efficient reuse of memory, optimized for fixed-size allocations aligned with OS page sizes.

methods.name: Rent
methods.description: Overrides the base method to rent a memory block of specified size, returning a MemoryPoolBlock if size is within limits.

methods.name: Lease
methods.description: Internal method to take a block from the pool, allocating a new slab if none are available.

methods.name: AllocateSlab
methods.description: Allocates a new slab, creates block tracking objects, and adds them to the pool.

methods.name: Return
methods.description: Returns a block to the pool for reuse, or disposes it if the pool is disposed.

methods.name: RefreshBlock
methods.description: Recreates and returns a block during finalization if a slab is being finalized.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes of all slabs and blocks, releasing resources.
